archetypes.name: dyn-main-health
archetypes.rationale: Main-health classification and commit-scoped run selection are new merge gates.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the new default-branch main-health helper and CLI. Focus on commit-scoped run selection, same-SHA failure-to-success flap handling, malformed GitHub JSON behavior, and wait semantics. Check that forked runs query the upstream repository with a bare branch name and that failures are fail-closed without masking an active red main. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
